title: add rag agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs update
author: Liam O'Connor
description: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples plus corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide engineers with end-to-end, tested examples that demonstrate agent construction, tool registration, and secure tool-calling patterns for RAG use cases. What this PR includes: new quickstarts under examples/rag-agent-tool-calling (Python and TypeScript), docs quickstart pages under site/content/docs/agents/rag-agent-tool-calling.md, updated RAG templates for common retrieval pipelines, reference config for KMS-backed API keys, and CI examples for smoke tests. Checklist: [x] add Python quickstart [x] add TypeScript quickstart [x] add docs page and TOC entry [x] register examples in examples index [x] add CI smoke tests [x] update README snippets. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan. This description is a single continuous string to preserve the GitHub PR body format.
